concept: One ordinary late report told twice. Leo's Thursday message gets a verdict that changes his feelings, not his actions; then the same desk, the same wall planner, and a row of three paper marks on the table edge (what he did, what it caused, ask) built one card at a time until the next step is a pin on Tuesday. Two weeks on, the message comes on Tuesday.
world: One office: a two-shot desk (You screen left, Leo screen right, the wall planner between them above the heads), a close on Leo at his side of the same desk, a plain quiz space for the check, and the presenter's bookends.

devices.what: The wall week planner between the two heads: Thursday circled as the due day, pages flip two weeks, the client call card slides off Thursday to next week, a check-in pin lands on Tuesday. Every time fact sits on it.

Three paper cards standing on the table edge in a row: 1 What he did, 2 What it caused, 3 Ask. Built one per beat b07 to b09, held through b10, each lit as named in b11, recalled as the presenter's card lines in b15.
The word proactive leaves the verdict bubble and sticks on Leo as a name tag (a label about who he is), holds while the action cloud asks which action, then peels off when the first mark replaces it.
The same desk two-shot, You left and Leo right, same looks and sides: the hook, the build of the marks, and the payoff two weeks on.
The one join material: a paper page turn, at the chapter into the check and at the time skip into the payoff.
